stories.title: A mathematician says he and Claude proved the Riemann hypothesis
stories.summary: Levent Alpöge posted a four-page note and millions of lines of Lean code claiming a proof of math's most famous open problem, first posed in 1859. Mathematicians started compiling it within hours.

stories.title: Fiona the hippo's necropsy finds the hat stuck in her intestine
stories.summary: The Cincinnati Zoo shared what killed Fiona and thanked fans for an outpouring of love.
